mapper.update: UPDATE t_train SET depart_date = CASE WHEN TIMESTAMP(CURDATE(), depart_time) > NOW() THEN CURDATE() ELSE DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) END, update_time = NOW() WHERE TIMESTAMP(depart_date, depart_time) <= NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.train_no, t.train_type, t.from_station_id, t.from_station_name, t.to_station_id, t.to_station_name, t.depart_date, t.depart_time, t.arrive_time, t.duration_minutes, t.status, t.create_time, t.update_time FROM t_train t JOIN (SELECT x.train_no, MIN(x.depart_date) AS min_date FROM t_train x WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_train_stock s WHERE s.train_id = x.id) GROUP BY x.train_no) m ON t.train_no = m.train_no AND t.depart_date = m.min_date WHERE t.status = 1 ORDER BY t.train_no

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_train (train_no, train_type, from_station_id, from_station_name, to_station_id, to_station_name, depart_date, depart_time, arrive_time, duration_minutes, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{trainNo}, #{trainType}, #{fromStationId}, #{fromStationName}, #{toStationId}, #{toStationName}, #{departDate}, #{departTime}, #{arriveTime}, #{durationMinutes}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
